subFacilities.sourceLine: The Company can borrow up to $ 6.5 billion under the Credit Agreement for general corporate purposes, with up to $ 500 million available for issuance of letters of credit.

uncommitted.sourceLine: The Company maintains uncommitted factoring facilities with a total capacity of $ 2.0 billion under which certain accounts receivable may be sold on a non-recourse basis to a financial institution.

uncommitted.description: incremental add-on capacity under Credit Agreement
uncommitted.sourceLine: The Credit Agreement includes an option to increase commitments up to $ 1.5 billion for a maximum total commitment of $ 8.0 billion.

programSize.sourceLine: Under our commercial paper program, we may issue short-term, unsecured commercial paper notes privately placed on a discounted basis through certain broker-dealers at any time not to exceed an aggregate amount of $ 6.5 billion.

outstanding.sourceLine: The commercial paper program had approximately $ 0.5 billion outstanding as of September 30, 2026 and an average interest rate of 4.09 %.

averageRate.sourceLine: The commercial paper program had approximately $ 0.5 billion outstanding as of September 30, 2026 and an average interest rate of 4.09 %.

backedBy.sourceLine: As of September 30, 2026, we had $6.5 billion of undrawn committed capacity under our revolving credit agreement (these amounts are available for general corporate purposes, including providing liquidity support for our commercial paper program), $6.0 billion of remaining capacity under our commercial paper program, and $6.5 billion in cash and short-term investments, approximately $1.2 billion of which was held by the parent company or certain non-regulated subsidiaries.
